description: Downloads a file from a public https link (50 MB max) and saves it inside the matter's Dropbox folder. Does not overwrite. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

matter_id.description: Matter identifier from find_matter or list_open_matters.

path.description: Destination file, relative to the matter folder, including the file name.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

source_url.description: Public https:// link to download the file from. 50 MB max.

name: upload_dropbox_file
title: Upload file to Dropbox
